activities.name: Invoice Received
activities.description: An invoice has been received from a vendor and entered into the system

activities.name: Invoice Scanned
activities.description: The physical invoice has been scanned and attached to the digital record

activities.name: Invoice Validation
activities.description: The invoice has been validated against purchase orders and receiving documents

activities.name: Three-Way Match
activities.description: The invoice has been matched with purchase order and goods receipt

activities.name: Price Variance Check
activities.description: Price variances between invoice and purchase order have been identified and reviewed

activities.name: Quantity Variance Check
activities.description: Quantity variances between invoice and goods receipt have been identified and reviewed

activities.name: Tax Calculation
activities.description: Tax amounts have been calculated and verified

activities.name: Approval Requested
activities.description: The invoice has been submitted for approval workflow

activities.name: Manager Approval
activities.description: A manager has approved the invoice for payment

activities.name: Finance Approval
activities.description: The finance department has approved the invoice

activities.name: Vendor Master Data Review
activities.description: Vendor information has been verified and updated if necessary

activities.name: Payment Terms Verification
activities.description: Payment terms have been verified and confirmed

activities.name: GL Account Assignment
activities.description: General ledger accounts have been assigned to the invoice

activities.name: Cost Center Assignment
activities.description: Cost centers have been assigned for expense allocation

activities.name: Payment Block Release
activities.description: Any payment blocks have been released

activities.name: Payment Scheduled
activities.description: The invoice has been scheduled for payment

activities.name: Payment Executed
activities.description: The payment has been executed and sent to the vendor

activities.name: Payment Confirmed
activities.description: The payment has been confirmed and reconciled

activities.name: Invoice Posted
activities.description: The invoice has been posted to the general ledger

activities.name: Document Archived
activities.description: The invoice and related documents have been archived
